name: Amimi Imai
source:
Amimi comes across as shy, but standoff-ish around strangers, but she opens up when she gets to know someone better.  She nicknamed herself “Hanabi” for her love of fireworks, and its ability to make people happy.  Her past experiences have her quietly battling her past demons.  A lover of long sleeves and PJ pants.

[From [url=https://www.tsofgame.com/characters]official website[/url]]
